name: Partner of a New Zealander Resident Visa

qualifying_event.description: For the partner of a New Zealand citizen or resident. Either the applicant already holds a partnership-based resident visa with the same partner and the relationship continues, or they have lived together in a genuine and stable relationship for at least 12 months at the time of application.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Evidence of a genuine and stable relationship (cohabitation, joint finances, etc.); sponsor's written support; may include an interview.

requirements.blocker_text: Living together with the New Zealand citizen/resident partner in a genuine and stable relationship for at least 12 months at time of application (or continuation of an existing partnership-based resident visa with the same partner).
The New Zealand partner must support the application in writing; immigration officers may request further evidence or interviews to verify genuineness.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of genuine, stable relationship (12+ months cohabitation)

outcome.duration_length: Resident Visa issued with 24 months of multiple-entry travel conditions

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand Operations Manual -- Partner of a New Zealander Resident Visa: 12-month genuine/stable relationship requirement, sponsor written support, direct grant of a second/subsequent Resident Visa with 24-month travel conditions (not a provisional pathway), dependent children provisions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). Grants Resident Visa status directly (not a temporary/provisional visa first), same 24-month-travel-condition-then-Permanent-Resident-Visa structure as nz_skilled_migrant_category.json and nz_active_investor_plus.json -- see nz_permanent_resident_visa.json.
